title: New GTA6 Map Highlights Only Confirmed Areas
description: A new community-made GTA6 map on Reddit highlights only the areas with officially confirmed shapes. Discover what it reveals about Leonida's true scale.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The GTA6 Community is Mapping the Unseen: A Look at the 'Confirmed Shapes' Project

As the gaming world eagerly awaits the next masterpiece from Rockstar Games, the r/GTA6 community on Reddit continues to channel its boundless energy into decoding every pixel of available footage. Recently, a fresh cartography project shared by user `/u/defonotDefaultUser` has captured the spotlight. Titled roughly as an adaptation of the famous YANIS map, this new iteration comes with a crucial twist: **it only includes areas with confirmed shapes.**

### Piecing Together Leonida with Surgical Precision

Ever since the historic December 2023 trailer debut—and the massive 2022 development leaks that preceded it—die-hard fans have been playing digital detective. From analyzing the curvature of a coastline in the trailer to matching horizon lines with real-world Florida geography, the community's dedication to reconstructing Vice City and the wider state of Leonida is nothing short of legendary.

However, the internet is also flooded with wildly speculative maps that inflate the game's actual size with wishful thinking. This is where this new community creation stands out. The author readily admits a disclaimer: *"Some things to note; It is not 100% accurate, some things may have slipped through."* By stripping away unfounded guesses and focusing strictly on verified visual data, this map offers a much more grounded perspective on what Rockstar is actually building.

### What the 'Confirmed' Map Tells Us

Limiting the scope to strictly verified outlines does more than just cut down on speculation; it highlights the current state of our collective knowledge:

* **Urban Density vs. Wilderness:** The confirmed zones heavily emphasize the sprawling metropolitan layout of Vice City alongside distinct marshland and rural borders, pointing towards a diverse ecosystem reminiscent of Florida's actual geography.
* **The Mystery Remains:** Vast swathes of the map remain blank or speculative. This serves as a healthy reminder that Rockstar Games has kept the vast majority of the game's true scale under wraps, ensuring plenty of surprises for day one.

### The Power of Community Engagement

In periods of official marketing silence from Rockstar, community-driven projects like this are the lifeblood of the fanbase. They transform the agonizing wait for news into an interactive, collaborative science project. While we wait for the next official trailer or screenshot drop, these fan-made cartographies give us a tangible glimpse into the sprawling playgrounds we will be exploring.

## Editor's Take

In a sea of over-hyped, wildly speculative custom maps, this restrained approach is refreshing. By sticking strictly to confirmed shapes, the creator provides a realistic baseline for the scale of GTA 6. It’s a testament to the community's analytical dedication and a smart way to temper expectations while fueling excitement.
